boot.name: Core Online
boot.desc: Stabilize the system to a usable state.
boot.hint: Advance the story to energy stable and build a power module.

first_purge.name: First Purge
first_purge.desc: Defeat 10 security programs on the link.
first_purge.hint: Enable Auto Purge and rack up wins.

subnet_access.name: Subnet Access
subnet_access.desc: Enter the subnet and reach floor 3.
subnet_access.hint: Deep scan in the story → enter the dungeon.

protocol_t1.name: Protocol Awakening
protocol_t1.desc: Reach hacking level 5 to unlock protocols.
protocol_t1.hint: Farm HXP via combat and network ops.

depth_10.name: Deep Node
depth_10.hint: Keep auto-exploring; elites appear every 5 floors.

core_breach.name: Core Breach
core_breach.hint: Launch a core raid from Progress, or hit floor 15.

echo_stable.name: Echo Stable
echo_stable.desc: After a protocol reboot, defeat the core again.
echo_stable.hint: Prestige, rebuild fast, raid the core once more.

abyss_watch.name: Abyss Gaze
abyss_watch.desc: Achieve 3 protocol reboots and 5 core guardian kills.
abyss_watch.hint: Loop the cycle: each reboot is faster; threat tier climbs with dungeon depth.

ascension_ready.name: Kernel Ascension
ascension_ready.desc: Achieve 3 protocol reboots, 3 core guardian kills, and reach dungeon floor 20.
ascension_ready.hint: You may now perform a Kernel Ascension: wipe all protocol research (including persist slots) for permanent Architecture Points.

region_pioneer.name: Cross-Border Migration
region_pioneer.desc: Perform your first network migration into another network region.
region_pioneer.hint: Unlock and migrate to a new region from the Network Regions panel.

region_conqueror.name: Region Conqueror
region_conqueror.desc: Clear the region cores of 2 network regions.
region_conqueror.hint: Every region has a different core: defeat the core of the region you are in to clear it.
